title: Project Tesseract (v3)
description: A pixel-art Pokemon-like adventure with scrolling camera, walking animations, tall grass encounters, shops, trainers, and a day/night cycle.
prompt: Better sure, but there are no walking animations, no grass in the wind int, trees and so on, I am also stuck on a single map/screen, the screen should scroll around with you as you move, to reveal more of the world, not load in as you get to the edge etc. We are also missing a lot of UI, the NPCs, monsters, most of the gameplay
